package.description: A tray traffic light that shows what Claude Code is doing, with notifications and answers from the phone.

en-US.description: A tray traffic light that shows what Claude Code is doing, with notifications and answers from the phone.
en-US.longDescription: A single-file Windows tray app (no installer) that shows with a coloured lamp whether Claude Code is working, waiting for you, compacting the conversation or done; sends push messages to your phone through ntfy; and lets you answer permission prompts and questions without going back to the window.
en-US.name: Claude Code Traffic Light
